transforms.operation: resize about image center to 80%, black pad, inverse-map boxes
resize about image center to 120%, center crop, inverse-map boxes

inference.coordinate_space: original input pixels after inverse transform

matching.algorithm: Greedy one-to-one highest-IoU matching, reference order confidence descending then coordinates, IoU >= 0.50
matching.class_aware_agreement: matched pair has identical canonical class
matching.class_switch: class-agnostic spatial match with different canonical class
matching.retention: matched reference detections / reference detections; descriptive only
matching.small_object: reference predicted box area < 1024 original-pixel squared

purpose: Bounded CPU prediction-consistency comparison; not an accuracy evaluation

robot_temporal_test.limitation: camera/robot motion and scene visibility vary; no tracking IDs or GT, so this is temporal repeatability evidence, not temporal accuracy
robot_temporal_test.metrics: adjacent-frame count changes, class-histogram changes, spatial matches and class switches
robot_temporal_test.scope: ordered frames from one fixed inspection/tree/viewpoint metadata group

selection.real_images: For each canonical image-level class, choose the lexicographically smallest SHA256 in the frozen Phase 2I 59-image cohort; source class is used only for stratified selection and never as object GT.
selection.robot_sequence: Choose the lexicographically first inspection/tree/viewpoint group having at least 12 complete hash-valid RGB metadata pairs; take the first 12 by numeric RGB timestamp.
